name: Geerling ai-benchmarks: RTX 4090 (in Intel 265K PC), Ollama, DeepSeek-R1-14b (Q4 distill), 92.49 tok/s eval rate, 464W peak
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Jeff Geerling, geerlingguy/ai-benchmarks issue #43, obench.sh on Ollama). Host: Intel Core Ultra 265K custom PC. Model: DeepSeek-R1-14b Ollama tag (Q4_K-class GGUF distill). Eval rate 92.49 tok/s; peak system power 464.2W during the run. Per-request decode, batch 1, Ollama default context. Detailed run log in the linked GitHub issue.
energy_basis: wall power at the plug measured alongside the run; 464.2W peak reported in the table
notes: Geerling also ran the same model on an RTX 4090 attached to a Pi CM5 (83.31 tok/s, 397.5W peak) — the 10% delta is the Pi's PCIe link and CPU bottleneck, not the GPU. Both figures are single-request decode.
